module: Flowgraph node "Set Clouds" (category dynamic_instant). Sets the cloud parameters. Input pins: objectId (optional id of a cloud object), coverage (0 to 1), exposure, windSpeed, height. Executed once (workOnce) or every frame in repeat mode.
notes: Without objectId, only coverage (setCloudCover) and windSpeed (setWindSpeed) are applied to the default clouds; exposure and height are ignored.
data.restoreCloud = true is defined but _executionStarted/_executionStopped are empty: nothing is restored (unused value).

postInit.desc: Configures the coverage pin as a 0 to 1 slider.

work.desc: In repeat mode, applies the parameters every frame.

setCloudParameters.desc: Calls core_environment.setCloudCoverByID/ExposureByID/WindByID/HeightByID if objectId is provided, otherwise setCloudCover and setWindSpeed.
